AI and Cloud Technology Series · Amazon Book Launch

From Sullia to the Global Technology Stage

A dream my grandmother believed in

I grew up in Sullia, near Mangalore, Karnataka, at a time when access to high-quality education was beyond reach for many girls in my hometown. When I began my IT journey in early 2000, my grandmother, Parvathi Shankar Bhat, Kodenkiri, blessed me, trusted me, and believed that I would achieve my dreams and travel the world.

More than 26 years later, I am sharing what I have learned through two practical books on enterprise AI and cloud reliability. My hope is to help students, job seekers, women entering technology, engineers, SRE practitioners and technology leaders build the skills and confidence to create real-world impact.

“Talent exists everywhere, but opportunity does not. Knowledge can help close that gap.”

Dedicated with love and gratitude to my grandmother, Parvathi Shankar Bhat, Kodenkiri.
Your faith in my dreams continues to inspire my journey.
